phone.subtitle: We use this for SOS and account recovery.

phone.devHint: Test mode: the code is 000000. A number ending in 00 signs in as an existing user; one ending in 11 is already taken.

recite.label: Recite
recite.sub: Prayer, recitation and ambient sound, guided by voice.
recite.alt: An older couple meditating side by side on floor cushions at home, each wearing a Svaraa pendant.

respond.label: Respond
respond.sub: Natural conversations that turn everyday requests into thoughtful support.
respond.alt: An older couple chatting during a walk through a leafy park, the woman touching her Svaraa pendant.

remind.label: Remind
remind.sub: Medicine, water and daily routines, without another screen to manage.
remind.alt: An older couple at the breakfast table taking their medicine with glasses of water, a pill organiser beside them.

rescue.label: Rescue
rescue.sub: An SOS connects the wearer to their trusted circle of care.
rescue.alt: A woman kneels beside an older woman seated on a bathroom floor after a fall, reassuring her.

recall.label: Recall
recall.lead: A little clarity for the day ahead.
recall.sub: A calm news briefing, today’s plans and helpful follow-through.
recall.alt: An older couple smiling over a notebook of plans at the breakfast table, a newspaper beside them.

repository.label: Repository
repository.sub: Conversation notes and personal stories, organised with permission.
repository.alt: An older couple share old photographs and stories with their daughter around the dining table.

riddle.label: Riddle
riddle.sub: Gentle yoga and cognitive play, at a comfortable pace.
riddle.alt: An older man does a seated arm stretch while an older woman works on a colourful tangram puzzle.

product.name: Svaraa Fold
product.body: An AI-powered, voice-first wearable for older adults and the families who care for them.
product.alt: Svaraa Fold pendant worn on its braided cord
